screening_decisions.reason: Primary cross‑sectional diagnostic accuracy study evaluating multiple biomarkers (HE4, CA125) and combined algorithms (ROMA, RMI) against histology in women with a pelvic mass. Meets all inclusion criteria (test combinations, reference standard).
Prospective diagnostic accuracy study of HE4, CA125 and ROMA in women with pelvic masses, comparing malignant vs benign/endometriosis, using histopathology as reference. Fits inclusion criteria.

Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study of the ADNEX multivariable model that combines ultrasound features and CA125, with histology as reference. Directly addresses test combinations of ultrasound and biomarkers.
Retrospective audit describing usage patterns of CA125 without formal evaluation of diagnostic accuracy or test combinations; does not meet DTA study design required.
External validation of a multivariable diagnostic model (ADNEX) that incorporates ultrasound and CA125, using histopathology as gold standard. Satisfies inclusion criteria.
Systematic review/meta‑analysis rather than a primary diagnostic accuracy study; review protocols exclude secondary evidence.
Primary study assessing RMI indices (which combine CA125, ultrasound, menopausal status) against histology; meets the cross‑sectional DTA criteria.
Prospective multicenter DTA study of HE4, CA125 and the ROMA algorithm in symptomatic women, using histopathology as reference. Directly evaluates biomarker combinations.
Diagnostic accuracy study comparing HE4, CA125 and ROMA in women with benign and malignant gynecologic disease, reference standard histology. Fits inclusion criteria.
Systematic review of symptom presentation; not a primary diagnostic test accuracy study of biomarkers or ultrasound.
Systematic review/meta‑analysis rather than original DTA data; excluded per protocol.
Epidemiological overview of cancer incidence; does not provide diagnostic accuracy data for ovarian cancer tests.
Prospective multicentre DTA study of the ADNEX multivariable model (ultrasound + CA125 + clinical variables) with histology as reference. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study of multiple biomarker/composite tests (CA125, HE4, RMI‑II, ROMA) in pelvic masses with histology reference; aligns with protocol.
Prospective case‑control DTA study assessing combined HE4 + CA125 against histopathology; fits inclusion of biomarker combinations.
Diagnostic accuracy study of HE4 and ROMA (biomarker‑based algorithm) with histology as reference; satisfies inclusion criteria.

Basic science/expression study; does not provide diagnostic accuracy data for test combinations.

Prospective DTA study of HE4 and CA125 (alone and combined) in women with suspicious cystic masses, reference standard histology; aligns with protocol.
